hook: Starve your order down to one vain giant knight, and watch every empty slot make him grander.
loop: Leave gaps so knights stay Proud, and Duel at Start of Combat.
Sold squires, empty slots and Duel wins feed your Champion.
A few huge knights kill enemies before anyone attacks.

growth.line: Champion gains permanent stats every End of Turn per empty slot and Proud unit; Gottfried multiplies in fight.

feel.early: Duel bodies kill the enemy across before fights.
feel.mid: Pick a feed: Champion, Proud chequerboard or Duel wins.
feel.late: Two or three giants on a nearly empty board.

stars.why: Multiplies himself by your empty slots, up to x4.
Grows alone in a corner, then sells into the Champion.
Crosses out your smallest unit to feed the Champion double.

card_short.u01: Grows while Proud; when sold, Champion takes his stats.
card_short.u02: Plain Duel body for early fights.
card_short.u03: Gives another unit Duel and stats, more if Proud.
card_short.u04: Duel winners gain stats permanently, double if Proud.
card_short.u05: From Tier 3, gold each turn on a small board.
card_short.u06: Duel; each win starts another Duel, twice a fight.
card_short.u07: If Proud, gives your Champion Shield at Start of Combat.
card_short.u08: Champion gains stats each turn per empty slot.
card_short.u09: If Proud, gets a Gizzard Stone each turn.
card_short.u10: Duels the enemy's biggest unit, in either row.
card_short.u11: Your Proud units gain stats every turn.
card_short.u12: Duel-win effects trigger twice, limits doubled too.
card_short.u13: Discovers a Knight; two on a small board.
card_short.u14: May destroy your smallest unit; Champion gains double its stats.
card_short.u15: Any tribe can be Champion; Champion grows per Proud unit.
card_short.u16: Champion Duels once per empty slot, up to three.
card_short.u17: Proud units get Duel; each first Duel takes no damage.
card_short.u18: In fight, +50% stats per empty slot: x4 when alone.
card_short.u19: Champion takes a quarter of each Duel loser's stats.
card_short.x01: Item: stats for a unit, double on your Champion.

builds.name: The Last Knight
builds.line: Sell and cross out everyone into one Champion; Gottfried finishes.

builds.name: The Proud Court
builds.line: Four lone knights in a chequerboard, all grown by Marshal and Reisig.

builds.name: Dawn Duellists
builds.line: Full board of Duellers; Hen and Cork-Pop turn wins into growth.

liked: Gaps as fuel: a board shape no other tribe asks for.
Sir Gottfried, a capstone whose price, an empty board, everyone can see.
worries: Sir Gottfried's x4 on a fed Champion could end fights before they start.
Master of the Cork-Pop, Hartmut and Herald could wipe a front row pre-fight.
changed: Refectory Prior now waits for Tier 3, so it's no free early buy.
Bilberry Hen and Pennon-Squire give double to Proud knights.
verdict: For one-giant-carry players: starve the board, keep slots empty and feed a single vain knight.
